title: Isizwe Esasingayithobeliyo Imithetho Yendalo
intro: Kwingingqi apho ibali layo liphindaphindeka khona kwixesha elidlulileyo, uluntu lwaluphila ngokuvukela imithetho yobunyulu. Izenzo zabo zazingazange zibonwe ngaphambili kangangokuba zikhunjulwa njengesilumkiso kubo bonke abantu. Yayingoobani le miphefumlo, kwaye yintoni eyabafikela?
clues: Sasihlala kwilizwe elikufutshane nendlela abahambi ababedla ngokudlula kuyo, kodwa sayenza yaba yingozi indlela yabo.
Senze izenzo ezingafanelekanga ekungekho mntu wakha wazenza ngaphambili.
Isithunywa esivela phakathi kwethu sasibiza ukuba sishiye iindlela zethu, kodwa samlahla saza safuna isohlwayo ukuba wayenyanisile.
Xa iindwendwe ezintle zifika kwisixeko sethu, sazama ukuzihlasela, singazi ukuba zizithunywa zentshabalalo.
Salunyukiswa ngesohlwayo esibi ukuba asiyi kuyeka, kodwa sahlekisa ngesilumkiso saza sahlala esonweni sethu.
Imvula yamatye evela ezulwini yasiwela, amakhaya ethu abhukuqwa, akwasala nelimdaka ngaphandle komqondiso kwabo bacingayo.

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
